faqs.question: What is included in Microsoft 365?
faqs.answer: Microsoft 365 includes premium Office apps, 1 TB OneDrive storage, advanced security tools, and AI-powered productivity features like Microsoft Copilot.

faqs.question: Can I use Microsoft 365 on multiple devices?
faqs.answer: Yes, Microsoft 365 works across PCs, Macs, tablets, and smartphones with real-time syncing.

faqs.question: Is my data secure with Microsoft 365?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Microsoft 365 includes threat protection, encryption, compliance tools, and advanced identity security.

faqs.question: Can I add or remove users anytime in Microsoft 365?
faqs.answer: Yes. Microsoft 365 licenses are flexible—admins can add, remove, or reassign user licenses at any time through the Microsoft Admin Center.

faqs.question: Does Microsoft 365 provide an admin center for managing apps, devices, and users?
faqs.answer: Yes. Microsoft 365 includes an Admin Center where IT teams can manage users, devices, permissions, security policies, and subscriptions in one centralized dashboard.
